title: Ram Charan and Sukumar Launch RC17 as Chiranjeevi Gives the Mahurat Clap
excerpt: The Rangasthalam pair reunited at a Hyderabad pooja ceremony on Sunday for the pan-India film backed by Mythri Movie Makers and T-Series. Title, cast and release date are still under wraps.
body:
• Ram Charan and director Sukumar formally launched their next film, tentatively titled RC17, at a pooja ceremony in Hyderabad on Sunday, November 1.
  • The Telugu-language film reunites the pair for the first time since Rangasthalam (2018); it is a pan-India production from Mythri Movie Makers and Sukumar Writings, presented by T-Series Films.
  • Chiranjeevi, Ram Charan's father, gave the ceremonial mahurat clap; IANS reported Ratnavelu as cinematographer and Anirudh Ravichander as composer.
  • The title, female lead, supporting cast and release date have not been announced. The project was first announced in March 2024.

The reunion Telugu audiences have waited eight years for is officially on the floors. Ram Charan and director Sukumar launched their next collaboration — tentatively titled RC17 — with a pooja ceremony in Hyderabad on Sunday, November 1, at 10:50 a.m., according to Filmfare. Megastar Chiranjeevi sounded the mahurat clapboard and performed the coconut-breaking ritual to bless the production, IANS reported.

A Rangasthalam reunion, scaled up

RC17 is Charan and Sukumar's second film together after Rangasthalam, the 2018 rural drama co-starring Samantha Ruth Prabhu that became a major critical and commercial success for both. The project was first announced in March 2024, when Charan shared a photograph with Sukumar confirming the reunion. Where Rangasthalam was a Telugu film that travelled, RC17 is being mounted from the start as a pan-India production: Mythri Movie Makers and Sukumar Writings produce, and the film is presented by Gulshan Kumar, Bhushan Kumar and T-Series Films, with T-Series also holding the music rights.

https://www.instagram.com/p/DfMPlN7v4Lu/

Mythri Movie Makers captioned its launch video: "The journey of #RC17 begins with the MEGA CLAP... Megastar @chiranjeevikonidela garu sounded the clapboard and blessed the entire team of #RC17." Producers Naveen Yerneni and Y. Ravi Shankar were joined at the ceremony by industry names including Naga Vamsi, Gopichand Malineni, Maruthi, Buchi Babu Sana and Harish Shankar, IANS reported.

What is confirmed — and what is not

IANS reported the technical leads as Ratnavelu on cinematography and Anirudh Ravichander on music. Beyond that, the makers are holding details back: no final title, no female lead or supporting cast, and no release date has been announced. Pinkvilla has reported the film is aiming for a 2028 release, but the production has not confirmed a date.

Charan arrives at RC17 off Peddi, the sports action drama directed by Buchi Babu Sana. For the diaspora audience, the practical details — US release pattern and showtimes — will only firm up once the title and date are official. What Sunday's launch settles is that the Rangasthalam team is back, this time with a national presenter and a pan-India brief from day one.
